answer_1.quote: Multi-document summarization (MDS) systems summarize the salient information from multiple documents about an entity...

answer_2.quote: We propose a new summary-level coverage-based fairness measure, Equal Coverage (EC)... We propose a new corpus-level fairness measure, Coverage Parity...

answer_4.quote: Performing human evaluation for fairness on summarization is challenging due to the need to read entire input document sets. Therefore, we perform experiments on the Amazon dataset... Each sample is annotated by three annotators recruited from Amazon Mechanical Turk...
answer_4.guideline: annotators are asked to read all reviews and identify all unique opinions. They then are asked to read the summary and rate its fairness as leaning negative, fair, or leaning positive.
